title: nan
authors: Qiu Z.; Lv J.; Lin D.; Yu Y.; Sun Z.; Zheng Z.
key_contribution: Presents a LiDAR-inertial navigation algorithm extracting grid and shell geometric features to enable accurate UAV pose estimation in GNSS-denied spatial grid structures like power plants.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
